SPEC:
Close-up design sheet of one game UI element: the SKY CLOCK for the top centre of the world map screen of a dark fantasy samurai RPG, same UI kit as the attached HUD and inventory (black-red lacquer, slim antique copper-gold double borders, diamond studs, small sakura clusters, red silk tassels, ivory serif numerals).
Show 3 variants side by side on a dark neutral background, each about 700 px wide:
A) a wide half-disc arc dial (like a sundial / astrolabe half-ring) with 24 hour ticks; the golden-white sun "Hoen" as a small radiant enamel disc on the arc, the silver moon "Sena" (crescent) and the lilac-violet moon "Iru" (half moon) as small enamel discs on an inner arc; a faint pale ring symbol (the Eye of the Rift) at the zenith; under the dial a slim plaque for date and time.
B) a horizontal strip sky band: a long lacquer cartouche showing a sky gradient (night violet - dawn pink - day gold - dusk crimson) with the sun and two moons as small discs placed along it and a gold needle for the current moment; date plaque below.
C) a round astrolabe medallion: a disc with day/night halves, sun and two moons on concentric rings, a gold pointer, date plaque under it.
Moons must clearly read as two different moons: Sena cold silver-white, Iru lilac-violet, slightly smaller. Elegant, slim, premium, readable at small size. Text only: "1 Peach 1047" and "18:40" on each plaque.
Input images: Image 1: reference for style, shapes and composition; Image 2: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
